_comment: gameVersionIds: CurseForge game-version IDs to attach to every upload. Leave empty to resolve by name from /api/game/versions (gameVersionNames). If a name matches none or several, the upload step fails and prints the candidates; then put the right ID(s) in gameVersionIds.
_comment_bridges: bridges: new folder -> old folder. While an entry is here, the release zip of that addon also carries addons/<old>/ (its settings bridge: a TOC with the old saved variables, so the first login moves them over). Remove the entries and the Better...Forever folders after the transition (about two weeks, at most a month).
